title: Anthropic Faces Market Sell-Off Following Record $81 Billion IPO
summary: Shares in artificial intelligence company Anthropic tumbled after completing the largest public market debut on record.
paragraphs: Artificial intelligence developer Anthropic pulled off the largest initial public offering on record, raising $81 billion, according to CNBC. However, following its blockbuster debut, the company quickly faced market turbulence, sharp stock declines, and intense anti-AI market sentiment.

BBC News and Al Jazeera reported that Anthropic's falling share prices coincided with a broader slide in technology stocks and financial markets. CNBC added that the sell-off followed pressures throughout the sector, including an ongoing crisis at Nvidia, whose stock plunged 14% to complete its longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis.

title: Nikhil Gupta Sentenced to Over 19 Years in US Sikh Assassination Plot
summary: An Indian national has received a prison sentence of over 19 years in the United States for plotting to kill a Sikh separatist leader.
paragraphs: Indian national Nikhil Gupta has been sentenced to more than 19 years in prison in the United States for his role in a murder-for-hire plot, Al Jazeera and BBC News reported. The sentence was handed down after Gupta conspired to hire a hitman to assassinate Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, a New York-based Sikh separatist leader.

Gupta entered guilty pleas in February to charges including murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering, according to BBC News. Al Jazeera confirmed that his resulting prison term amounts to 19 years behind bars.

summary: Cincinnati Zoo's internet-famous hippopotamus Fiona has died after ingesting a visitor's hat.
paragraphs: Fiona, the renowned hippopotamus at the Cincinnati Zoo, has died at the age of 9, France 24 reported. The animal suffered fatal complications after ingesting a knitted hat that was dropped into her enclosure.

The hippo gained international recognition and became an internet sensation after being born prematurely weighing only 13kg. France 24 noted that zoo staff expressed extreme sadness following her death on Thursday, ending nearly a decade of worldwide public affection for the animal.
